## TTM Technologies

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission
systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and
technologically advanced interconnect products, including printed circuit boards ("PCB"s) and
substrates.

## The missing layer between your data & your AI

It all comes together in one platform—knowledge graphs, data observability, conversational
analytics, and contract-first governance—so AI can scale with accuracy and control.
* Jump to card card1:Context layer
* Jump to card card2:Trust layer
* Jump to card card3:Access layer

Context layer

Federated knowledge graph gives every asset a semantic identity, so AI understands business meaning,
not just column names. Bottom-up cataloging across all sources, with a Steward Agent to maintain
definitions and contract-first governance.

Trust layer

Continuous monitoring is built into the platform. It validates data health in real time, enforces
data contracts, and provides AI agents with automated trust signals, enabling them to operate
without human checkpoints.

Access layer

Natural language interface (NL-to-SQL), context-aware and embedded in workflows, lets business users
query data in Slack or Teams, delivering instant, governed answers through approved templates and
real-time validation.

## Deploy in days, not months

Transform your data catalog into an intelligence platform: the only solution that combines a
federated knowledge graph, real-time quality and observability, conversational analytics, and
contract-first governance for agentic AI. Deploy in days with 100+ connectors, friendly UI, and
immediate value for business users and data teams alike.

### Discover and understand all your data instantly

**Data & IT Leaders **can eliminate 80% of time wasted searching for data with AI-powered natural
language search, federated knowledge graphs, and hierarchical glossaries with instant business
context – built on governed metrics, relationships, and business logic defined upfront.

### Pass audits without slowing AI innovation

**Data Quality & Governance** leaders can replace rigid validation workflows with watchlists that
provide visibility without blocking contributors, embed security policies directly in data
contracts, and maintain automated audit trails with field-level lineage.

### Activate AI agents with production-ready data

**AI/ML Engineering Leaders **can eliminate the 60% AI failure rate by enabling agents to verify
data through contracts, understand context through knowledge graphs, and monitor it with real-time
observability—delivering accurate and consistent results with transparency into how answers are
produced.

[ Start Tour ][131]

## One unified platform. Infinite agentic possibilities.

From data discovery to AI activation, empower every user with intelligent, governed access to your
enterprise knowledge graph.

## Enterprise-ready use cases for agentic AI, regulatory compliance, and self-service analytics
* Discover
* Trust
* Activate

### Discover, understand, & access all your data instantly

**Unified Data Catalog and Data Marketplace** for centralized discovery and ready-to-use data
products and contracts.

**Federated Knowledge Graph** with domain-specific ontologies to maintain local autonomy while
connecting to the enterprise semantic layer.

**Conversational Interface **dynamic question-and-answer interactions, allowing users to ask
follow-ups without switching reports.

**Data Access Request Management** for webhooks and use-case management for data access, reducing
workloads.

**Peer-to-Peer Sharing** between domain/sub-catalogs breaks down silos while maintaining governance.

**Chrome Plugin** provides comprehensive context and business definitions directly in BI dashboards.

### Build trust, mitigate risk, and ensure regulatory compliance

**Complete Data Lineage** with visualization connectors for semantic models and end-to-end tracking
of data transformations.

**Contract-First Data Products** with embedded security policies and automated violation detection
for data reliability.

**End-to-End Data Integrity** monitoring from ingestion to consumption with automated quality issue
resolution.

**Steward Agent** defines governed metrics and relationships, reducing semantic drift and ensuring
consistent analytics over time.

**AI Glossary Builder** for universal business language and automated term extraction from BI
dashboards.

**Built-in Compliance** with automated classification and audit trails for GDPR, CCPA, and BCBS 239
regulations.

### Activate trusted data with agents and automations

**Custom AI Agents** bridge your data catalog and AI assistants for contextual answers with
definitions, ownership, and lineage.

**Slack and Teams Integration** delivers analytics in-flow, reducing friction and expanding usage
beyond BI tools.

**Natural Language Data Access** with pre-trained agents that understand business questions and
generate SQL with governance controls.

**Automated PII Detection** with AI-driven classification and tagging of sensitive data across all
sources.

**Real-Time Data Validation** through secure MCP server connections delivering trusted metadata to
AI tools.

**Intelligent Quality Workflows** that automatically validate inputs, flag issues, and orchestrate
quality checks across workloads.

## The missing layer between your data & your AI

It all comes together in one platform—knowledge graphs, data observability, conversational
analytics, and contract-first governance—so AI can scale with accuracy and control.
* Jump to card card1:Context layer
* Jump to card card2:Trust layer
* Jump to card card3:Access layer

Context layer

Federated knowledge graph gives every asset a semantic identity, so AI understands business meaning,
not just column names. Bottom-up cataloging across all sources, with a Steward Agent to maintain
definitions and contract-first governance.

Trust layer

Continuous monitoring is built into the platform. It validates data health in real time, enforces
data contracts, and provides AI agents with automated trust signals, enabling them to operate
without human checkpoints.

Access layer

Natural language interface (NL-to-SQL), context-aware and embedded in workflows, lets business users
query data in Slack or Teams, delivering instant, governed answers through approved templates and
real-time validation.

## Deploy in days, not months

Transform your data catalog into an intelligence platform: the only solution that combines a
federated knowledge graph, real-time quality and observability, conversational analytics, and
contract-first governance for agentic AI. Deploy in days with 100+ connectors, friendly UI, and
immediate value for business users and data teams alike.

### Discover and understand all your data instantly

**Data & IT Leaders **can eliminate 80% of time wasted searching for data with AI-powered natural
language search, federated knowledge graphs, and hierarchical glossaries with instant business
context – built on governed metrics, relationships, and business logic defined upfront.

### Pass audits without slowing AI innovation

**Data Quality & Governance** leaders can replace rigid validation workflows with watchlists that
provide visibility without blocking contributors, embed security policies directly in data
contracts, and maintain automated audit trails with field-level lineage.

### Activate AI agents with production-ready data

**AI/ML Engineering Leaders **can eliminate the 60% AI failure rate by enabling agents to verify
data through contracts, understand context through knowledge graphs, and monitor it with real-time
observability—delivering accurate and consistent results with transparency into how answers are
produced.

of data transformations.

**Contract-First Data Products** with embedded security policies and automated violation detection
for data reliability.

**End-to-End Data Integrity** monitoring from ingestion to consumption with automated quality issue
resolution.

**Steward Agent** defines governed metrics and relationships, reducing semantic drift and ensuring
consistent analytics over time.

**AI Glossary Builder** for universal business language and automated term extraction from BI
dashboards.

**Built-in Compliance** with automated classification and audit trails for GDPR, CCPA, and BCBS 239
regulations.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by

strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market

standards.

seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API

reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their

Working with Cerebras lets us treat speed as a first-class design parameter. When your agent runs at
~1000 tokens per second, you have the opportunity to optimize all parts of the agent together,
including context retrieval, UI, and model behavior. Cerebras enables us to pursue an entirely new
set of bets, from deeper codebase understanding to fundamentally new interaction patterns.

Scott Wu
CEO, Cognition

Inference is the moment a model actually does something useful for a customer, and right now, speed
and performance are the bottleneck. What we've built with Cerebras solves that: by splitting the
inference workload across Trainium and the CS-3, and EFA connecting them, each system does what it's
best at. The result is inference that's an order of magnitude faster and higher performance than
what's available today.

David Brown
Vice President, Compute & ML Services, AWS

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### Project Management

Our approach to every project begins with fostering a constant exchange between the applicable API,
Drug Product and Lipid Excipient process development teams involved. Ongoing alignment with
analytical, quality and compliance support allows for faster and more consistent results, regardless
of where your project starts.

### Explore our CDMO capabilities across Technology Platforms
* [**Peptides**][175]: End‑to‑end development and manufacturing of complex peptide APIs from
  early-stage to commercial supply.
* [**Injectables**][176]**:** Clinical-to-commercial development and manufacturing of sterile
  injectable drug products, including aseptic fill and finish. 
* [**Small Molecule & Highly Potent Drug Substance**][177]:** **Scalable** **complex small molecules
  and highly potent compounds from early development through commercial supply. 
* [**Small Molecule & Highly Potent Drug Product**][178]: Flexible production of complex oral and
  sterile dosage forms, including highly potent compounds, from clinical to commercial supply.
* [**Nanomedicine**][179]:** **Integrated development and manufacturing of lipid excipients and
  nanomedicines, including LNP formulation and scalable delivery systems. 
* [**Lipids**][180]: Specialized development and large-scale manufacturing of high-quality lipid
  excipients for advanced drug delivery systems and emerging nanomedicines.

Seamless Supply with True End-to-End Support

## Why Choose CordenPharma?

As pharma innovators, your CDMO partner must bring the expertise, scale, and regulatory strength to
support your programs at every stage. With decades of experience across six technology platforms, a
global network expansion spanning three continents, and hundreds of years of combined
facility expertise, we deliver true end-to-end services across the complete drug lifecycle, from
drug substance to drug product. Our integrated capabilities and expanded capacity enable consistent
execution, supporting development, clinical supply, and large-scale commercial manufacturing with
confidence.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

# When will you die?

The answer may be shocking!

### [auto1.jpg]Fully Automated RF Heat Sealing Machinery Systems Available
###  
### Hall Dielectric offers fully automated and semi-automated RF Heat Sealing Systems to meet your
### manufacturing demands.  We have rotary turntable systems as well as inline machines available.

## [fourposterpress.jpg]RF Heat Sealing Dies and RF Tooling

At Hall Dielectric we manufacture a variety of Standard, and Automated Systems. In addition to these
systems we can also fabricate all RF Heat Sealing Dies and RF Tooling Accessories for your Radio
Frequency Welders. 

### Hall Dielectric is truly a ONE-STOP SHOP for all your RF Heat Sealing needs.

# The finest Radio Frequency Heat Sealing Equipment and Warranty in the business!  

We specialize in manufacturing custom RF Heat Sealing Machinery and RF Welding Systems that enable
our customers to achieve their manufacturing demands.  From standard machinery to fully automated
systems, we can design the exact type of machinery you need to meet your product manufacturing
needs.  We are a family owned and operated company proudly manufacturing our equipment here in the
USA.  We offer the Best Warranty in the Industry and our Service is second to None.  For quality
machinery and great customer service, you have come to the right place for your RF Heat Sealing
Equipment.

 

## What is RF Heat Sealing / RF Welding?

Do you have a product that you need to fabricate from two or more sheets of plastic materials?  The
preferred method of sealing two or more plastic sheets of material is RF Heat Sealing or RF
Welding.  RF Welding can also be referred to as Dielectric Sealing and Electronic Heat Sealing.  The
sheets of material can vary from thin sheets to very rigid plastic products.  The RF Heat Sealing
Machine consists of a lower platen (sometimes heated) and an upper heated platen.  You mount your RF
Sealing Die to either the upper or lower platen to RF Seal your product.  When the machine is
activated, the upper platen comes down and makes contact with the lower platen and the die is then
activated with RF Energy to RF Seal your materials together.  The RF Heat Sealing Machine utilizes a
combination of heat, pressure and RF Energy to RF Seal your products together.  The RF Energy that
is applied to the materials in the shape of the RF Die, activates the polar molecules of the plastic
sheets of material, combining them to become one.  The result is a RF Seal that is stronger than the
actual material itself. 

### CALL TO DISCUSS YOUR SPECIFIC PRODUCT NEEDS AND WE CAN DESIGN A MACHINE TO FIT YOUR EXACT
### MANUFACTURING NEEDS

# 800-849-2824

[automated_small.jpg]Fully Automated RF Heat Sealing Machinery Systems Available
 
Hall Dielectric offers fully automated and semi-automated RF Heat Sealing Systems to meet your
manufacturing demands.  We have rotary turntable systems as well as inline machines available.

 [Automation_smweb.jpg]

##  

### Hotstamping

We can provide you with hotstamping capabilities and incorporate the hotstamp press into the
manufacturing process.

 

[stand3.jpg]

 

 

 

## Hall Dielectric has all your Heat Sealing Solutions!

 

To find out what we can do to cut your manufacturing costs, please use our Contact Form or CALL US
NOW - 800.849.2824.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Do Identium UHF RFID products work on India's approved frequency band?

Yes. Our UHF readers and tags operate in the 865–867 MHz band designated for RFID use in India, so
they work across the country and avoid the interference and compliance issues of hardware tuned only
for other regions.

Are Identium products WPC approved for use in India?

Yes. Our UHF equipment is WPC compliant for the 865–867 MHz band — the regulatory requirement for
operating RFID systems in India. We also hold BIS certification alongside ISO 9001 and ISO 14001.

What read range can I expect from Identium UHF tags and readers?

Read range depends on the tag type, antenna, reader power and the surface the tag is mounted on, so
it varies by application — short range for cards and wristbands, longer range for fixed asset and
inventory tags. Share your use case and we will recommend the right tag and antenna combination.

What certifications does Identium hold?

We are certified to ISO 9001 (quality management) and ISO 14001 (environmental management), and our
products carry BIS certification and WPC approval for India — covering both our manufacturing
processes and the regulatory compliance of the hardware we ship.

Is there a minimum order quantity, and can products be customised?

We manufacture a full range of UHF tags, cards, wristbands, antennas and readers and support
customisation such as printing, encoding and form factor. For specific MOQs and options on your
chosen product, contact us with your requirements and we will confirm what is available.

What is the lead time for an order?

Tags typically have a turnaround of 5 to 10 days. Lead times for readers, printers and customised
items vary with configuration and quantity, so we confirm a delivery timeline when you place your
order.

Do you provide SDKs and integration support for your readers?

Our UHF readers follow standard RFID protocols and integrate with common middleware and software
platforms. For drivers, SDK availability or integration guidance for a specific reader model,
contact our team and we will share the relevant resources.

How do I order, and do you ship across India?

You can order through India RFID Store with proper GST invoicing on every purchase. We manufacture
at our Delhi factory and ship nationwide across India, with warranty and after-sales support on our
products.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Do Identium UHF RFID products work on India's approved frequency band?

Yes. Our UHF readers and tags operate in the 865–867 MHz band designated for RFID use in India, so
they work across the country and avoid the interference and compliance issues of hardware tuned only
for other regions.

Are Identium products WPC approved for use in India?

Yes. Our UHF equipment is WPC compliant for the 865–867 MHz band — the regulatory requirement for
operating RFID systems in India. We also hold BIS certification alongside ISO 9001 and ISO 14001.

What read range can I expect from Identium UHF tags and readers?

Read range depends on the tag type, antenna, reader power and the surface the tag is mounted on, so
it varies by application — short range for cards and wristbands, longer range for fixed asset and
inventory tags. Share your use case and we will recommend the right tag and antenna combination.

What certifications does Identium hold?

We are certified to ISO 9001 (quality management) and ISO 14001 (environmental management), and our
products carry BIS certification and WPC approval for India — covering both our manufacturing
processes and the regulatory compliance of the hardware we ship.

Is there a minimum order quantity, and can products be customised?

We manufacture a full range of UHF tags, cards, wristbands, antennas and readers and support
customisation such as printing, encoding and form factor. For specific MOQs and options on your
chosen product, contact us with your requirements and we will confirm what is available.

What is the lead time for an order?

Tags typically have a turnaround of 5 to 10 days. Lead times for readers, printers and customised
items vary with configuration and quantity, so we confirm a delivery timeline when you place your
order.

Do you provide SDKs and integration support for your readers?

Our UHF readers follow standard RFID protocols and integrate with common middleware and software
platforms. For drivers, SDK availability or integration guidance for a specific reader model,
contact our team and we will share the relevant resources.

How do I order, and do you ship across India?

You can order through India RFID Store with proper GST invoicing on every purchase. We manufacture
at our Delhi factory and ship nationwide across India, with warranty and after-sales support on our
products.

***Innovative Power Products*** has been designing and manufacturing RF and Microwave passive
components since 2005. We use the latest design tools available to build our baluns, 90 degree
couplers, directional couplers, combiners/dividers, single-ended transformers, resistors,
terminations, and custom products.

For us, “Engineering Driven, Customer Focused” is not just a tag line but the way we do business. We
continuously invest in R&D efforts, pushing our products to broader bands, smaller sizes and higher
powers to ensure our customers can create their next-generation designs utilizing the newest
state-of-the-art technology on the market. And our ISO 9001:2015 registered quality and Lean
Management systems assure our customers of a reliable product at a competitive price, creating a
winning situation for both companies while building lasting relationships.

IPP is an ITAR-registered company whose products are utilized every day in military, medical,
industrial and consumer markets. Our customer service team, sales representatives, and distributors
around the world are all available to help you find the right product for your application. This
support, along with our strong engineering foundation, dependable products, and fast delivery are
just a few reasons why IPP has become a market leader.

This website shows our most popular products with links to detailed mechanical drawings with
electrical specifications, performance data, S-parameters, and .STP files when available.

**Innovative Power Products’ Unique [Interactive S-Parameter Viewer][71]: ** This one-of-a-kind
online viewer allows you to scroll, zoom, point and select a sub-band. The viewer adds the
flexibility of showing out-of-band data as well as the value at each data point just by hovering the
cursor over the data point. Use the checkboxes to view individual S-Parameters, or choose to view by
groups:  All Transmission, All Reflection, All Isolation or All Parameters. You can view data in
Log-Magnitude view, as a Smith Chart, or as Unwrapped Phase.

At Innovative Power Products, we are always creating value for our customers.

Thank you for considering Innovative Power Products as your supplier for RF and microwave passive
components.

## Wi-Fi, Network, and Security Services
* ### Business Wi-Fi & Wireless Networks
  
  Reliable wireless connectivity is critical to modern business operations. We design, install, and
  support secure indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi networks built for performance, coverage, and scalability.
  
  Our solutions include high-density Wi-Fi for offices and public spaces, long-range point-to-point
  and point-to-multipoint wireless bridges, cellular signal enhancement with repeaters and DAS
  systems, and IoT-ready networking for smart devices and sensors.
  
  From initial site surveys and network design to professional installation and ongoing support, we
  ensure your wireless infrastructure is fast, reliable, and built to grow with your business.
  
  CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO
* ### VoIP Phone Systems for Business
  
  Clear, reliable communication is essential for every business. Our VoIP phone solutions range from
  simple hosted systems to full enterprise-grade deployments designed for scalability, redundancy,
  and advanced call handling.
  
  We deliver feature-rich VoIP platforms with auto attendants, call routing, voicemail to email,
  mobile apps, and analytics, along with specialized solutions including emergency 911 compliant
  phones, long-range cordless systems, cellular-enabled voice failover, and both coin and cashless
  payphone services.
  
  From design and deployment to ongoing support and management, we ensure your phone system works
  seamlessly across offices, remote staff, and mission-critical environments.
  
  [**CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO**][27]
* ### Structured Cabling & Network Installation
  
  Need reliable network wiring for your business? We design and install complete network
  infrastructure and low-voltage cabling for offices, warehouses, campuses, medical facilities, and
  multi-building sites.
  
  Our team handles **structured cabling** from end to end, including **Cat6/Cat6A Ethernet cable
  runs**, **network drops**, **patch panels**, **server racks**, **MDF/IDF buildouts**, and clean,
  labeled cable management. We also install and terminate **fiber optic cabling** (single-mode and
  multi-mode) for high-speed backbones, long-distance links, and building-to-building connectivity,
  plus **coax** and other low-voltage systems as needed.
  
  Whether you are adding a few Ethernet ports or building a full network from the ground up, we

  and advanced call handling.
  
  We deliver feature-rich VoIP platforms with auto attendants, call routing, voicemail to email,
  mobile apps, and analytics, along with specialized solutions including emergency 911 compliant
  phones, long-range cordless systems, cellular-enabled voice failover, and both coin and cashless

  [**CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO**][27]

  Need reliable network wiring for your business? We design and install complete network
  infrastructure and low-voltage cabling for offices, warehouses, campuses, medical facilities, and
  multi-building sites.

  runs**, **network drops**, **patch panels**, **server racks**, **MDF/IDF buildouts**, and clean,
  labeled cable management. We also install and terminate **fiber optic cabling** (single-mode and
  multi-mode) for high-speed backbones, long-distance links, and building-to-building connectivity,
  plus **coax** and other low-voltage systems as needed.
  
  Whether you are adding a few Ethernet ports or building a full network from the ground up, we
  deliver a professional installation that is standards-based, documented, and built to scale.

  environments.

  scalable storage options with motion recording, AI-powered person and vehicle detection, license

  video retention.

  matters most.

  What sets us apart is our **24/7/365 **customer support team. When there is an issue, your staff
  and guests speak directly with a real person who knows your systems and works to resolve problems
  quickly. You do not field the calls. You do not troubleshoot. We handle it.
  
  Our support options are flexible, scalable, and built around your environment, budget, and
  business goals, so you get exactly the level of coverage you need without paying for what you do
  not.

[ Learn More About Our Services ][28]

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### **Q: How does a managed service provider actually save my business money?**

A: Most businesses are overpaying for internet without realizing it. We recently helped a business
paying for multiple separate ISP connections, one for cameras, one for the office, one for phones,
one for guests. They only needed one. We replaced all of it with a single internet source and built
separate secure networks within it using VLANs. Guest Wi-Fi, cameras, VoIP phones, office computers,
and printers all run on the same connection but completely isolated from each other. The result was
hundreds of dollars saved every single month. One bill. One network. Everything working together. 👉
[Read more in our article: Stop Letting Your Internet Be Lazy][29]

#### **Q: What does Interstate Telecommunications actually do?**

A: We are a managed services provider focused on the five systems every modern business depends on:
Wi-Fi, IP security cameras, VoIP phone systems, access control, and structured cabling. We design,
install, and support all of it. Then our 24/7 U.S.-based customer support team keeps it running long
after installation. We help businesses better utilize their technology, make it more efficient, and
save money in the process. 👉 [Read more in our article: 7 Benefits To Hiring a Managed Service
Provider][30]

#### **Q: What happens when something stops working at my business?**

A: That is exactly what our 24/7 customer support team is for. When your internet goes down, a
camera stops recording, or your phones go offline, a real person answers the phone and works to get
everything back online, often before you even notice there is a problem. No waiting on hold with an
ISP. No sending staff to reboot routers. We handle it around the clock, every day of the year. 👉
[Read more in our article: 24/7 Support: How Our Team Keeps You Connected][31]

#### **Q: How is Interstate Telecommunications different from other managed service providers?**

A: We have been in the managed services space since 1991. What sets us apart is our 24/7 U.S.-based
customer support team and our commitment to staying long after installation. We do not just fix
problems. We partner with businesses to make sure their technology is working efficiently and doing
more for them every day. We own the outcome for as long as you are our customer. 👉 [Read more in
our article: 7 Benefits To Hiring a Managed Service Provider][32]

### Solutions for the challenges you face

We’re inspired by positive patient outcomes. Over more than 80 years we’ve delivered
industry-leading technology, expert service, and specialized education to make a world of difference
in the lives of care providers and their patients.

[Neuro Solutions][103]
[Service & Support][104]

### Products

We put clinicians first in the consideration and development of each solution we provide. We deliver
innovative and trusted solutions to screen, diagnose, and treat disorders affecting the brain and
neural pathways.

[Neuro Products][106]

### Service & Support

We are dedicated to providing unparalleled service to ensure a seamless experience, helping our
partners to deliver the highest standard of care and achieve the best possible patient outcomes.

[Service & Support][107]

### Education

We are committed to helping healthcare providers worldwide feel confident they can achieve the best
possible results. Natus Academies provide expert knowledge, clinical expertise and advanced
education – whatever your role, wherever you work.

[Neuro Training Academy][108]

Everything you need to start, scale and manage your business.

Sell any type of digital download such as ebooks, software, design assets, templates, video, music
and more. If you can save it, you can sell it.

Sell your expertise through 1:1 coaching sessions. Easily set up online meetings with clients using
integrations with Zoom, Calendly and more.

[Learn more][33]

Allow your customers to pay you on a recurring basis to access your digital downloads or membership
group. Manage your members easily.

promotions and more.

Bring Payhip's robust features and high-converting checkout experience to any existing website with
our simple embed feature.

# A better internet starts with privacy and freedom

Take control of your data with end-to-end encryption.

[Create a free account][143][Compare plans][144]
Trusted by over 100 million users and organizations
Average app rating[4.5 stars]
[CNET, Independent IndyBest and PCMag Editors' Choice]
Recommended by the experts

## Communicate and browse. Privately.

[Proton Mail]
[Proton Calendar]

### Proton Mail and Calendar

Defeat spam, tracking, and ads with encrypted [email][145] and a secure calendar.

[Get it for free][146][Explore Proton Mail
][147]
[Proton VPN]

### Proton VPN

Browse privately and access content from anywhere with a secure, fast [VPN(new window)][148].

[Get Proton VPN][149][Explore Proton VPN
][150]
Mail

#### No trackers. No distractions. Just your email.

VPN

#### Stay protected online, wherever you go.

VPN

#### Ultra-fast gaming, anywhere in the world.

Calendar

#### Organize your schedule privately.

Previous slide
Next slide

## Store, share, collaborate. Securely.

[Proton Drive]

### Proton Drive

Safeguard your files and photos with end-to-end encrypted [cloud storage][151].

[Get it for free][152][Explore Proton Drive
][153]
[Proton Docs]

### Proton Docs

Edit as a team with [collaborative documents][154], safe from prying eyes.

[Get it for free][155][Explore Proton Docs
][156]
[Proton Sheets]

### Proton Sheets

Protect and organize sensitive data in encrypted [online spreadsheets][157].

[Get it for free][158][Explore Proton Sheets
][159]

## Defend your digital life from hackers. Effortlessly.

[Proton Pass]

### Proton Pass

Generate and store strong passwords with a [password manager][160] that automatically syncs across
all your devices and alerts you to breaches.

[Get it for free][161][Explore Proton Pass
][162]
[Proton Authenticator]

### Proton Authenticator

Sync and back up your two-factor authentication (2FA) codes across all devices with a secure
[authenticator app][163].

[Get it for free][164][Explore Proton Authenticator
][165]

## Host and join confidential meetings

[Proton Meet]

### Proton Meet

Collaborate with your team or catch up with family and friends knowing your [video calls][166] are
protected by end-to-end encryption.

[Start a meeting][167][Explore Proton Meet
][168]

## Powerful AI that respects your privacy.

[Lumo AI]

### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

## Choose an internet where your privacy comes first

One account for all Proton services.

[Create a free account][187]

> transparent and offering bug bounties, they stay ahead of security threats.

# A better internet starts with privacy and freedom

Take control of your data with end-to-end encryption.

[Create a free account][143][Compare plans][144]
Trusted by over 100 million users and organizations

## Communicate and browse. Privately.

[Proton Mail]
[Proton Calendar]

### Proton Mail and Calendar

Defeat spam, tracking, and ads with encrypted [email][145] and a secure calendar.

[Get it for free][146][Explore Proton Mail
][147]
[Proton VPN]

### Proton VPN

Browse privately and access content from anywhere with a secure, fast [VPN(new window)][148].

[Get Proton VPN][149][Explore Proton VPN
][150]

### Proton Drive

## Defend your digital life from hackers. Effortlessly.

### Proton Pass

Generate and store strong passwords with a [password manager][160] that automatically syncs across
all your devices and alerts you to breaches.

[Proton Authenticator]

### Proton Authenticator

Sync and back up your two-factor authentication (2FA) codes across all devices with a secure
[authenticator app][163].

][165]

## Host and join confidential meetings

[Proton Meet]

### Proton Meet

Collaborate with your team or catch up with family and friends knowing your [video calls][166] are
protected by end-to-end encryption.

[Start a meeting][167][Explore Proton Meet
][168]

## Powerful AI that respects your privacy.

[Lumo AI]

### Lumo by Proton

An [AI assistant][169] where every conversation is actually confidential.

[Start a chat][170][Explore Lumo
][171]

## Protect your business with easy-to-use encrypted solutions.

[Proton]

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

## Our story begins at CERN, where the web was born

View details

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

[Read our story
][185]

## Built by the community, for the community

View details

Proton is a community-first organization, created through a public crowdfunding campaign and built
with community input. Our only source of revenue is subscriptions from users.

We exist only to serve you, not advertisers or other third parties. By choosing Proton, you join a
movement of millions of volunteers, contributors, and users creating an internet that puts people
first.

[Join our community
][186]

One account for all Proton services.

# Award-winning program performance to orchestrate simultaneous operation of collocated VHF/UHF
# radios, to improve and increase mission communications, in sea, air and land systems.

## To orchestrate means to arrange and combine for maximum effect, and that is exactly what RF
## Products does for communications in hostile or humanitarian missions.

## Award-winning program performance to orchestrate simultaneous operation of collocated VHF/UHF
## radios, to improve and increase mission communications, in sea, air and land systems.

## To orchestrate means to arrange and combine for maximum effect, and that is exactly what RF
## Products does for communications in hostile or humanitarian missions.

## Award-winning program performance to orchestrate simultaneous operation of collocated VHF/UHF
## radios, to improve and increase mission communications, in sea, air and land systems.

VHF/UHF Tunable Bandpass Filters & Multicouplers
* Bandpass and Notch tunable filters
* In bands from 30 MHz to 2 GHz
* Manual-knob, fast-motor, or very-fast-electronic tunable filter models
* Single filters to 5-port multicouplers
* Existing or modified for specific needs
* Multicouplers incorporate unique combining networks less than 0.2 dB insertion loss
* Multicoupler versions available as transmit/receive or receive-only

[Learn More: 30-88 MHz][14]

Transmit/Receive, Multi-Mode, Multi-Band, RF Distribution System (M3B RFD)
* Improves & increases platform mission capability, while RFPinc’s Remote Control Unit with
  R2D2^{TM} reduces operator workload
* Built on RF Products’s cosite interference & antenna population solutions
* Non-Stovepiped and Reconfigurable enabling operation in each band of a radio’s capability
* Scalable so the same part number boxes can be used across different platform configurations,
  reducing logistics costs

[Learn More: 108-174 MHz ][15]

Complete Radio System Design & RF Analysis
* RF Products works with you to design the best Radio/M3B RFD/Antenna configuration
* We provide cost/time efficient RF analysis for accurate prediction of the overall radio system
* Our support won’t sink program-preparation or bid-&-proposal budgets.
* Forget about cost overruns after contract award
* Forget about arguments over contract specification interpretation when the design to be delivered
  is not “what the customer really wanted”

## Our Mission

### Lifetime Connectivity

[**At RFS we specialize in the design and manufacture of premium, future-ready cable solutions for
customers across the globe. With over 120 years of heritage in the industry, we build reliable and
long service life connectivity systems. Because we care about our collective future.**][239]

[

### An RFS Guide to FRMCS

][241]

As railway operators prepare for the rollout of the Future Railway Mobile Communication System
(FRMCS) standard, tackling migration is one of the biggest challenges. Despite this, many
conversations focus on FRMCS at a technical level rather than the practicalities of rolling out the
new framework.

### Macro Site Connectivity

][244]

power connectivity solutions. Explore different topologies, our installation-focused approach, and
real-world case studies that show how we build future-ready infrastructure for long-term
performance.

  ### [Markets][52]
  * #### [Aerospace & Defense][53]
    
    Advanced materials with high reliability under extreme conditions, critical for aerospace,
    commercial aircraft and defense applications.
  * #### [Automotive & EV/HEV][54]
    
    Rogers is a leading automotive advanced materials supplier with a wide range of industry
    solutions to power, protect and connect vehicles.
  * #### [Connected Devices][55]
    
    Enabling electronic devices and more to operate interactively or autonomously by use of wireless
    protocols.
  * #### [Footwear & Impact Safety][56]
    
    Advanced material technologies that provide flexible comfort and wearable impact protection.
  * #### [General Industrial][57]
    
    Industrial engineers and designers rely on Rogers’ advanced materials to enable reliability,
    efficiency and performance.
  * #### [Major Appliances][58]
    
    Rogers increases energy efficiency with high quality, performance-optimized power electronics.
  * #### [Medical][59]
    
    Rogers enables high quality patient care in applications ranging from medical instruments to
    patient cushioning and wound care.
  * #### [Portable Electronics][60]
    
    Rogers provides complex and compact electronics with superior fabrication and protection.
  * #### [Printing][61]
    
    R/bak® cushion mounting materials provide shock absorption, compressibility, improved
    registration and reduced dot gain in printing applications.
  * #### [Rail][62]
    
    Solutions to power and protect mass transit rail systems.
  * #### [Wind & Solar][63]
    
    Enabling system efficiency and reliability for wind and solar renewable energy sources.
  * #### [Wired Infrastructure and Data Centers][64]
    
    Materials for applications in data center & wired infrastructure environments.
  * #### [Wireless Infrastructure][65]
    
    Low-loss, high frequency advanced materials with well-controlled dielectric properties to enable
    microwave and RF applications, including mobile networks.

  ### [Markets][52]
  * #### [Aerospace & Defense][53]
    
    Advanced materials with high reliability under extreme conditions, critical for aerospace,
    commercial aircraft and defense applications.
  * #### [Automotive & EV/HEV][54]
    
    Rogers is a leading automotive advanced materials supplier with a wide range of industry
    solutions to power, protect and connect vehicles.
  * #### [Connected Devices][55]
    
    Enabling electronic devices and more to operate interactively or autonomously by use of wireless
    protocols.
  * #### [Footwear & Impact Safety][56]
    
    Advanced material technologies that provide flexible comfort and wearable impact protection.
  * #### [General Industrial][57]
    
    Industrial engineers and designers rely on Rogers’ advanced materials to enable reliability,
    efficiency and performance.
  * #### [Major Appliances][58]
    
    Rogers increases energy efficiency with high quality, performance-optimized power electronics.
  * #### [Medical][59]
    
    Rogers enables high quality patient care in applications ranging from medical instruments to
    patient cushioning and wound care.
  * #### [Portable Electronics][60]
    
    Rogers provides complex and compact electronics with superior fabrication and protection.
  * #### [Printing][61]
    
    R/bak® cushion mounting materials provide shock absorption, compressibility, improved
    registration and reduced dot gain in printing applications.
  * #### [Rail][62]
    
    Solutions to power and protect mass transit rail systems.
  * #### [Wind & Solar][63]
    
    Enabling system efficiency and reliability for wind and solar renewable energy sources.
  * #### [Wired Infrastructure and Data Centers][64]
    
    Materials for applications in data center & wired infrastructure environments.
  * #### [Wireless Infrastructure][65]
    
    Low-loss, high frequency advanced materials with well-controlled dielectric properties to enable
    microwave and RF applications, including mobile networks.
* [Business Units][66]

  frequency, high speed and high power electronics through design, development and application
  support required to deliver quality, reliable solutions.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is SRFS Teleinfra?

SRFS Teleinfra is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of RF and telecom infrastructure products,
offering solutions such as antennas, RF cables, connectors, and 5G components for communication
networks.

What products does SRFS Teleinfra offer?

SRFS Teleinfra provides a wide range of products including RF antennas, RF cables, connectors,
adapters, splitters, combiners, GPS antennas, and 5G telecom components.

Does SRFS Teleinfra provide telecom services?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra offers telecom services such as site surveys, installation, commissioning,
network optimization, microwave services, and indoor/outdoor coverage solutions.

What industries does SRFS Teleinfra serve?

SRFS Teleinfra serves telecom, defense, aerospace, industrial, and commercial sectors by delivering
RF and communication infrastructure solutions.

Does SRFS Teleinfra support 5G technology?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra manufactures and supplies 5G components, including antennas, power splitters,
and RF solutions designed for modern telecom networks.

What are the key services offered by SRFS Teleinfra?

Key services include in-building solutions (IBS), network testing, telecom infrastructure
deployment, CCTV installation, and RF system integration.

Where does SRFS Teleinfra supply its products?

SRFS Teleinfra supplies products globally, including countries like the UAE, UK, Nepal, Kenya, and
France.

What makes SRFS Teleinfra different from competitors?

SRFS Teleinfra stands out due to its strong R&D focus, high-quality products, global supply
capability, quick production turnaround, and customer-centric approach.

Does SRFS Teleinfra offer customized RF solutions?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra provides customized RF and microwave solutions tailored to specific client
requirements and applications.

Is SRFS Teleinfra certified for quality standards?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra is ISO 9001 certified and ensures high reliability and performance standards
across its product range.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is SRFS Teleinfra?

SRFS Teleinfra is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of RF and telecom infrastructure products,
offering solutions such as antennas, RF cables, connectors, and 5G components for communication
networks.

What products does SRFS Teleinfra offer?

SRFS Teleinfra provides a wide range of products including RF antennas, RF cables, connectors,
adapters, splitters, combiners, GPS antennas, and 5G telecom components.

Does SRFS Teleinfra provide telecom services?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra offers telecom services such as site surveys, installation, commissioning,
network optimization, microwave services, and indoor/outdoor coverage solutions.

What industries does SRFS Teleinfra serve?

SRFS Teleinfra serves telecom, defense, aerospace, industrial, and commercial sectors by delivering
RF and communication infrastructure solutions.

Does SRFS Teleinfra support 5G technology?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra manufactures and supplies 5G components, including antennas, power splitters,
and RF solutions designed for modern telecom networks.

What are the key services offered by SRFS Teleinfra?

Key services include in-building solutions (IBS), network testing, telecom infrastructure
deployment, CCTV installation, and RF system integration.

Where does SRFS Teleinfra supply its products?

SRFS Teleinfra supplies products globally, including countries like the UAE, UK, Nepal, Kenya, and
France.

What makes SRFS Teleinfra different from competitors?

SRFS Teleinfra stands out due to its strong R&D focus, high-quality products, global supply
capability, quick production turnaround, and customer-centric approach.

Does SRFS Teleinfra offer customized RF solutions?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra provides customized RF and microwave solutions tailored to specific client
requirements and applications.

Is SRFS Teleinfra certified for quality standards?

Yes, SRFS Teleinfra is ISO 9001 certified and ensures high reliability and performance standards
across its product range.

## A One-Stop Shop For All Your Company Data Needs!
* COMPANY DATA
* AI
* B2B
* API
* REPORT

TradeAtlas’ global database provides the most up-to-date information about overseas importers and
exporters for companies aiming to make trade connections in international markets and monitor their
customers & competitors. The importers’ and exporters’ data on TradeAtlas is obtained from bill of
lading data and customs records. Therefore, all the information on the database comes from actual
and realized transactions.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][41]

With the Potential Importers solution, you can discover the companies that have not imported a
product or product group in the target market you have selected but have a very high potential to
import in a matter of seconds with nearly 100% accuracy. We provide the most suitable importer and
supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the
shipments (during the last 12 months / or / from 2020 till the latest available data). Please feel
free to contact us for more details, pricing, shipments/company count and a sample file.

[CONTACT US >>][45]

TradeAtlas’ global database provides the most up-to-date information about overseas importers and
exporters for companies aiming to make trade connections in international markets and monitor their
customers & competitors. The importers’ and exporters’ data on TradeAtlas is obtained from bill of
lading data and customs records. Therefore, all the information on the database comes from actual
and realized transactions.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][41]

With the Potential Importers solution, you can discover the companies that have not imported a
product or product group in the target market you have selected but have a very high potential to
import in a matter of seconds with nearly 100% accuracy. We provide the most suitable importer and
supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the
shipments (during the last 12 months / or / from 2020 till the latest available data). Please feel
free to contact us for more details, pricing, shipments/company count and a sample file.

At Tongyu Communication, we deliver cutting-edge Tongyu Technology solutions for global
connectivity. Our Products Center features high-performance base station antennas for 5G/4G
networks, precision MW antennas for Point-to-point Microwave Link, and advanced RF components for
4G/5G Radio Head. Explore our satellite communication antennas for reliable global coverage,
innovative FWA products for fixed wireless access, and high-speed optical products for next-gen
networks. As a trusted telecom solution provider, we engineer robust solutions for telecom operators
and system integrators worldwide.

As The Health Intervention Company, Unicity designs and develops innovative nutritional products
that make healthy living doable in an on-the-go world.

[A journey of discovery for Unicity International ]

## A journey of

## discovery

Unicity began as one product, but it has since become a thriving global movement that promotes good
health and wellness for millions. While Unicity has grown, our purpose—Make Life Better—has remained
the same.

[
**See more of our story**
][6]

## Real solutions

## for your health

With manufacturing sites and warehouses strategically placed around the world, Unicity is dedicated
to creating high-quality products that promote optimal health and wellness for everyone.

[Pouring Unicity's Unimate into cup]
[Supported by science - Unicity International]

## Supported by

## science

various clinical studies, reputable certifications, US patents, promotions by scientific journals
and studies, and more.

[

**Explore Unicity Science**

schedule.

lifestyle.

— **Ananya Gupta, Delhi**

**Our Customer-Centric Policy**

Unicity is committed to the highest standards of ethics and integrity. We take immense care to
ensure that our customers and associates are not misled by any claims related to our products or
business opportunity. We take all complaints seriously, and any concerns related to our products or
business practices are addressed promptly. If you have faced, or know someone who has faced, any
such issues, we encourage you to reach out to us. You may contact our Grievance Cell at 1800 102
2467. We are deeply focused on customer satisfaction and offer a customer-centric refund policy
designed to ensure a positive experience for every customer.

Use #Unicity and share your journey to healthy living on your social feed.
